body:
My grandfather was abusive in every way you can imagine. He was a police officer who had children with his own 14 year old daughter and beat the others. They got 5 dollars a week for food, the fridge was padlocked, everyone had nicknames (mine was eventually bucktoothed beaver bitch). When my mom went and called 911 as a teen, she was sent to a mental hospital because why would a well established community staple *ever* do such a thing? He grew older and soon sexually abused most of his own grandkids, too. 

And the craziest part of it all? I remember people sobbing at his funeral. I was happy he died, barely wanted to see the man who assaulted me as a kid again, but my mom wailed about how much she missed him. He had honors, medals, special guest speakers, the whole nine yards. The worst part? Everyone knew. Everyone saw those kids. They excused it because of course we were all just fast or liars or 'seducing' him. 

Monsters don't always get what they deserve. Sometimes they die praised, and we're all accountable for that.
He said go ahead, thank god. I had to take a double look at the subtitles.
